thread:
jordan: Paging. Post-deploy v3.2.1 rolled at 2024-02-27 15:10 UTC. We're seeing a regression on runtime: tail latency spiking from ~400ms -> 2s for several routes. Kernel fallback and batching window collapse on canaries. Anyone oncall?
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: latency spike on /v1/generate. p50->p95 crossing threshold (400ms->2s). Auto-paged eng-oncall. Graph: https://ops.redwood/graphs/abcd1234
amal: I'm on. Looking at metrics — kernel_fallback_count up across eu-west-1 canaries. Batch_window median down to single-digit ms, causes microbatch collapse. My gut: kernel selection change in v3.2.1. Recommend feature-flag kill-switch to revert selector.
sarah: Confirming on host gpu-12. Sample logs:
```
2024-02-27T15:12:05Z WARN kernel_fallback selected fallback_kernel_xla
2024-02-27T15:12:05Z INFO batch_window_ms=8 -> collapsed
2024-02-27T15:12:06Z ERROR kv_cache_miss_rate=0.62
```
jordan: Can we flip the kill-switch for the kernel selector? @amal
amal: Flip with this (canary scope):
```
/flags set runtime.kernel_selector v1 --scope canary
```
Note: this reverts some perf gains for long-context flows but should stop fallback.
jordan: I'm initiating rollback for canary slice to v3.2.0 now:
```
deploy rollback --release v3.2.0 --slice canary-12 --reason "kernel_fallback regression"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started by jordan. Rollback ID rb-20240227-01. Targets: 12 pods. Streaming status: 3/12 -> 8/12 -> 12/12.
sarah: Early metrics: p50 stable, p95 trending down toward baseline. Live graph: https://ops.redwood/graphs/rollout_rb-20240227-01. Node evictions normalized, batch window reopening.
maya: Customer impact: CS triage saw ~87 slow-response tickets, 3 enterprise customers reported >5s timeouts. Notifying AEs and drafting statement.
amal: Rollback finished + flag reverted. Traffic stabilizing, p95 ~480ms now. :white_check_mark:
jordan: Good. Handoff to eng-oncall for full RCA and follow-up. Assigning to sarah and amal for postmortem and test coverage fixes. Keep page open 1h to verify.
oncall-bot: HANDOFF: eng-oncall assigned: sarah, amal. Severity: sev2. Create postmortem ticket PM-2024-02-27-01.
maya: CS note sent to affected customers, ETA for analyst postmortem: 48h. I'll coordinate updates.
sarah: saving traces/logs to /var/log/incidents/rb-20240227-01 and linking eval runs. Will run kernel_selector unit matrix tomorrow.
jordan: Action items: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) add regression test for kernel selector under small-batch patterns, 3) consider graceful fallback strategy rather than global kill-switch. Thanks all.
